title: Building New Game Teams Before the Game Is Clear
prompt: Build a trust-building team formation simulation inspired by Supercell's Spark program. Five anonymous silhouetted characters orbit a central 'game idea' node; the player drags constraint tokens (Budget Limit, Time Box, Unclear Brief) onto the team and watches social connections form or break as arrows animate between characters. The goal is to reach 'team cohesion' before the idea node fades. Warm, pastel startup-office aesthetic with hand-drawn doodle edges.
